# ResizableRegion

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:resize` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

## When to use

Pointer and keyboard-operable split region with a customizable handle icon.

- Provide a controlled user-resizable application pane.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for static columns; use CSS grid.

**Alternatives:**

- [Application layout](./layout.md) (nearest)
- [Split Panel](./wa-split-panel.md) (prefer-over)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/resizable-region` — exports `ResizableRegion`, `clampRegionSize`, `resizeRegionFromPointer`, `wireResizableRegions`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/resizable-region` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/resizable-region.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireResizableRegions` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-resizable-regions` (required).
- Wiring: `clampRegionSize` from `@kerfjs/ui/resizable-region` (optional).
- Wiring: `resizeRegionFromPointer` from `@kerfjs/ui/resizable-region` (optional).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/resizable-region`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiresizable-region), [`@kerfjs/ui/wire-resizable-regions`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiwire-resizable-regions) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- horizontal
- vertical
- start edge
- end edge
- collapsed
- custom handle icon
- hidden separator
- slide, fade-slide, or instant content
- clipped, scrolling, or popup-visible content
- inline, overlay, or hidden responsive presentation
- safe-area restore control
- top-corner or inline restore placement

**CSS-value props** (typed builders from `@kerfjs/ui/css-values`; raw CSS strings are rejected):

- `restoreInset`: length grammar; raw values: forbid; helpers `px`, `rem`, `em`, `pct`, `space`, `lengthVar`, `calc` — e.g. `restoreInset={space("xs")}`

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `adjustable-pane-boundary`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

## State and wiring

- size — controlled (required)

**Wiring:** `wireResizableRegions` is required.

- Retain and invoke the disposer.
- Persist committed size in the application when persistence is required.

**Wiring-owned state attributes** — never render, remove, or branch on these as app state:

- `data-handle-inset` on `kui-resizable-region` (`wireResizableRegions`): Present while a clipping edge clamps the region: the handle and its focus ring sit inside the region instead of overhanging that edge.
- `data-resizing` on `kui-resizable-region` (`wireResizableRegions`): "true" during an active pointer drag of the handle.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: conditional · padding: conditional (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The region delegates visible separator geometry and hit-area padding to its orientation-specific handle.

## Accessibility

- Preserve separator naming, value ARIA, and keyboard behavior.
- Keep handleIcon decorative and free of interactive descendants; the separator owns focus, naming, and pointer/keyboard interaction.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-resizable-region`, `kui-resizable-region__content`, `kui-resizable-region__handle`, `kui-resizable-region__handle-icon`, `kui-resizable-region__restore`.

Never put `kui-resizable-region`, `kui-resizable-region__content`, `kui-resizable-region__handle`, `kui-resizable-region__handle-icon`, `kui-resizable-region__restore` on an element you write; render `ResizableRegion` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text-link`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-radius-s`, `--kui-resizable-region-edge-extent`, `--kui-resizable-region-background`, `--kui-resizable-region-handle-active-color`, `--kui-resizable-region-handle-color`, `--kui-resizable-region-overlay-z`, `--kui-resizable-region-popup-z`, `--kui-resizable-region-restore-inset`, `--kui-resizable-region-restore-z`, `--kui-resizable-region-separator-color`, `--kui-resizable-region-size`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).

## Diagnostics

- `KUI-C106` (error) when wireResizableRegions is absent: ResizableRegion requires wireResizableRegions for pointer and keyboard operation.
